role: Scripted server mutations for --dev agent mode (give, slot, clear, tp, state, xp, time, weather, gamerule, setblock, fill, difficulty, summon, purge, orb, hurt, hanging): validated and queued by tick, applied by the lockstep hook at the head of the server tick.
notes: lane/pick: the summon whitelist includes Ghast (native dev.c builds it with a gh_world on any dimension's pool). lane/entrender: the "entity" op spawns the render scenes' projectiles, primed TNT and falling blocks from NBT keys (Motion, direction, Fuse, TileID, Data, potionValue, fire); a tape with it is Java-only. lane/netherfire: the summon whitelist includes Blaze (fight-blaze-s42). lane/idxentity: the summon takes "loot" (setCanPickUpLoot after the egg) and "breakdoors" (a zombie's func_146070_a); csrc/engine/dev.c mirrors both. lane/harness2: the summon's "child" sets IsBaby and Age -24000, so it takes Zombie, PigZombie and every EntityAgeable (native dev.c: the age before the placement re-centres the half box), dev-child-s1; a setblock or fill over a container spills it (the action's block env), dev-spill-s1.
